file_contract.onset: Source crop to first sample exceeding -45 dB relative peak, <=0.25 ms pre-roll. After layering, remove pre-contact noise up to first 1 ms RMS block above -32 dB relative max RMS; <=0.25 ms pre-roll, <=0.5 ms entry fade.
file_contract.tail: Trim to -48 dB relative + <=12 ms, then absolute -50 dBFS + <=12 ms after headroom; final 18 ms cosine-squared fade, exact zero endpoint.
file_contract.processing: Decode, mono downmix, 65 Hz high-pass / 14.5 kHz low-pass, bandlimited 48 kHz resampling with FFmpeg. Crop, bandlimited rate change / layering if listed. Global headroom only; film loudness belongs to mixer.
file_contract.scope: Original 45 one-shot variants. Additions use addition_contract and their per-file methods/layers.

review: Measured only. No listening review was possible. Source descriptions/file labels support the intended event; timbre and suitability require owner audition.
